identity.name: Code review minimum bar
identity.purpose: Soft-judge a code diff on six criteria, each scored 0-1. Aggregate >= 0.7 with no zero-criterion passes the bar; otherwise the review is blocking and names the single most urgent fix.

criteria.rubric: Score 1 if the linter and formatter pass on the touched files with zero errors and zero warnings. Score 0.5 for warnings only. Score 0 for any errors.
Score 1 if the project's static type check passes on the touched files. Score 0 for any type error. No partial credit.

Score 1 if new behaviour has a corresponding new or updated test that asserts the change. Score 0.5 for a test that exercises the path but does not assert the new behaviour. Score 0 if no test covers the new behaviour.
Score 1 if introduced identifiers read clearly in context with no need for an accompanying comment. Score 0.5 if a comment is needed. Score 0 for misleading or contradictory names.
Score 1 if no API keys, tokens, passwords, or credentials appear anywhere in the diff. Score 0 if any secret material is present, regardless of intent.
Score 1 if the diff touches only the files named in the predict. Score 0.5 for incidental touches that are clearly mechanical. Score 0 for substantive changes to files outside the predict.
